study_identification_part.si_4_title: Mapping the neuroanatomical heterogeneity of OCD using a framework integrating normative model and non-negative matrix factorization

dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.detail: Single-site sample of first-episode untreated OCD patients and matched healthy controls recruited at The First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University/community
dc_1_datasets_using_in_this_study.supporting_text: "Ninety-eight first-episode and drug-naive patients with OCD were recruited from outpatient services of the Department of Psychiatry, the First Affiliated Hospital of Zhengzhou University... One hundred and thirty healthy controls (HCs) were recruited from the community"

answer.SINGLE-SITE: healthy controls for normative model (healthy distribution) and OCD patients for individualized deviations and factor analysis

dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.detail: HCs (n=130) provide the healthy distribution for the normative model; OCD patients (n=98) are evaluated for individualized GMV differences and downstream NMF factor analysis
dc_2_purpose_of_each_dataset.supporting_text: "T1-weighted magnetic resonance images of 98 first-episode untreated patients with OCD and matched healthy controls (HCs, n = 130) were acquired. We derived individualized differences in gray matter morphometry using normative model and parsed them into latent disease factors using NMF."

dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.detail: Normative model based on healthy controls; no train/validation split reported
dc_3_number_of_healthy_control_of_each_n.supporting_text: "T1-weighted magnetic resonance images of 98 first-episode untreated patients with OCD and matched healthy controls (HCs, n = 130) were acquired."

dc_4_age_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: HC age reported as mean (SD) in years; no range provided for HCs

dc_5_sex_info_of_each_normative_nodel.detail: HC male count reported; female count inferred as total HC minus male
